I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread to confirm the correction: the 2026 Marrow Fieldworks renewal is for 87 seats, not 268.

Hollis's earlier message with 268 is still saved in the brain. To keep anyone from reading that number as current, I also saved the correction as its own fact under Marrow Fieldworks. It says 87 replaces the 268 from earlier that morning and points to both messages. This was the first fact saved under that account. The brain only catches exact duplicates right now, so the two numbers can't merge or collide.
